text:
maria: Customer (acme-fin) reports sudden spike in LLM API latency (200-800ms -> 2-4s) + intermittent 502s. They say traffic from their private VPC is egressing via our EU hub even though their VPC is in us-west. I have their flow logs and a tcpdump.

chris: Can you paste the tenant id + a quick traceroute / curl output?

maria: tenant_id: acme-fin-prod, vpc: vpc-456, private deployment. curl -v against /v1/generate shows TLS to api.redwood.com resolved to eu-proxy.redwood.net (34.203.x.x) and TLS SNI has eu proxy cert. Flow log excerpt: `src=10.200.12.34 dst=34.203.45.12 nat_src=52.14.201.77 nat_dst=34.203.45.12`.

leo: tcpdump hint: SYN outbound to 34.203.45.12 then NATed: `tcpdump -n -i eth0 host 34.203.45.12 and port 443` shows src 52.14.201.77 after SNAT. That nat_src is in EU NAT pool.

sophie: paste traceroute?

maria: ```traceroute to api.redwood.com (34.203.45.12), 30 hops max
 1  10.200.12.1 (10.200.12.1)  0.34 ms  0.28 ms  0.24 ms
 5  203.0.113.5 (203.0.113.5)  12.6 ms  12.3 ms  12.1 ms
 8  198.51.100.3 (198.51.100.3)  35.9 ms  36.1 ms  36.0 ms
 11  34.203.45.12 (34.203.45.12)  120.4 ms  119.9 ms  120.1 ms```

infra-bot: Route-change detected: prefix 52.14.0.0/16 accepted via peer-89 (hub-eu) at 2026-03-10T14:32:11Z.

chris: This looks like an egress NAT/peering preference issue: their private VPN → onprem edge → hub-peering → EU hub NAT pool. Are we doing any src-prefix-based route preference?

leo: Not for this tenant. Current BGP route-map prefers next-hop based on longest match + community. I suspect the source IP used after SNAT falls into EU NAT pool which our routing identifies as local to EU hub, so traffic loops there. Could be NAT address re-use between hubs.

sophie: Two immediate actions: 1) Ask net-infra to add a source-prefix-based policy for vpc-456 so nat_src stays in USW pool. 2) Short-term, have runtime attach `region=us-west-1` in routing context for private deployments to bypass smart fallback.

maria: Customer cannot set region param — they're on private control plane. They need us to fix network policy.

leo: I'm opening INF-5234: attaching flow logs, tcpdump, traceroute, and BGP updates. Proposed fix: update route-map to prefer local-hub for prefixes matching our onprem NAT pools and add a dedicated NAT pool for their tenant (52.23.x.x). Also add BGP community `local-prefer:usw` for vpc-456. ETA ~4h.

chris: Also want runtime change: when deployment_type == "private" and egress_nat_pool in hub_eu, skip automatic cross-region fallback. Otherwise smart routing will re-route to eu when it sees eu-nat. I'll file RUNTIME-1187.

sophie: Noted, I'll coordinate with runtime. If we gate fallback by `deployment_id` it should avoid misclassification.

maria: I'll update the customer with repro steps and ETA. Advise them not to reconfigure VPN while we patch.

maria: thanks y'all :thumbsup:

chris: assigning to leo + runtime triage.
